description: A global signed-correlation inequality and an explicit nearest-neighbor defect and cross-entropy floor for independent per-site round labels in ideal parallel decoding of a zero-field Ising chain.
integrity: Algebraic proof with exact bridge conditionals and finite-state rational regression checks. Prior broad exact output recurrences are credited; novelty comparison is bounded and not an independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Open finite chain, zero field, \(0<|\lambda|<1\), exact conditional one-site predictors, exogenous batches, and iid round labels for the quantitative \(1/K\) conclusion; neither KL divergence nor optimality of the bound is claimed. No assertion for adaptive/coordinated selection or approximate denoisers.
title: Universal two-point correlation contraction and a finite-round defect floor for parallel Ising unmasking
